definitions.gloss: spiriting away, mysterious disappearance attributed to supernatural forces
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese belief that when a person — especially a child — vanished without explanation, they had been hidden away by gods, spirits, or tengu. In modern usage, refers to any sudden, inexplicable disappearance.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{神隠|かみかく}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧。
⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{行方不明|ゆくえふめい}→行方不明：14039_yukuefumei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{神隠|かみかく}し⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}んだ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: In the old days, disappearances were called kamikakushi.

examples.english: A girl from the village suddenly vanished one day, and people whispered that she had been spirited away.

notes:
USAGE:
A word rooted in Japanese folklore. Historically, unexplained disappearances of people — particularly children — were attributed to gods (⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧) or supernatural beings like ⟦{天狗|てんぐ}→天狗：06522_tengu⟧ who would ⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ (hide) the person. The word became widely known internationally through the Studio Ghibli film ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{千尋|ちひろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神隠|かみかく}し (Spirited Away, 2001).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神隠|かみかく}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to be spirited away
- {神隠|かみかく}しにあったよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as if spirited away
- ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{千尋|ちひろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神隠|かみかく}し: Spirited Away (film title)
